description: This Java source file defines the `AclModificationInvalidException` class, which is a specialized exception indicating invalid modifications to an Access Control List (ACL) for a 'Thing'. The class includes metadata, builder patterns, and JSON parsing capabilities, and is part of the Eclipse Ditto project.
